newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- off in light volume.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- off in light volume.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices were off almost 1/8 in light trading Friday morning as the week comes to close, traders said.
"It is quiet. We are off about an 1/8," said one trader. "It is in line with the contracts, munis were off 1/4 and Treasuries 3/8."
"It will be light volume and I suspect people will be heading to the doors early," a trader said.
In otherwise quiet primary market activity, $25.5 million of Orange County, Calif., revenue certificates of participation were priced by Smith Barney Inc. with a top yield of 5.22 percent in 2014.
Treasuries were off after the data, with the long bond down 9/32 at 101-14/32 to yield 6.51 percent.
September municipal bond futures were off 9/32 to 120-8/32, while September Treasury bond futures were off 13/32 to 114-8/32.
Standard & Poor's Blue List of secondary market offerings edged up to $1.102 billion on Friday from $989 million on Thursday.
